attacks.name: Stealthy Shuriken
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Torrential Slash
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.

svp-54.name: Greninja ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Incessant Punching
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

svp-55.name: Kangaskhan ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10-142.name: Gapejaw Bog
rules: Whenever either player puts a Basic Pokémon from their hand onto their Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

swsh10-147.name: Irida
rules: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh10-148.name: Jubilife Village
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 5 cards. If they do, their turn ends.

swsh10-159.name: Zisu
rules: Draw cards until you have 1 more card in your hand than your opponent.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

abilities.name: Concealed Cards
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Moonlight Shuriken
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh10-46.name: Radiant Greninja
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh11-160.name: Lake Acuity
rules: All Pokémon that have any Water or Fighting Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) take 20 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Heat Boost
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. During this turn, your Fire Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Painful Spoons
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

swsh12-59.name: Radiant Alakazam
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh5-125.name: Escape Rope
rules: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6-145.name: Klara
rules:
Choose 1 or both:
• Put up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
• Put up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

abilities.name: Cotton Lift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
